paper_title: The NANOGrav 15-year Data Set: Search for Signals from New Physics
notes: This NANOGrav pulsar timing array paper searches for gravitational wave signals from new physics models (cosmic strings, domain walls, scalar-induced GWs, inflationary GWs, ULDM, primordial black holes). While it derives 95% credible intervals on model parameters via Bayesian analysis of GW spectral constraints (reported in Table 4 and Figures 13-18), it does not report measured exclusion limits on any of the canonical AxionLimitBench coupling types (g_aγγ, g_ae, g_an, g_ap, g_d, 1/f_a, χ, g_B-L, d_e, d_me, g_N, g_B, etc.). The constraints are on GW-related quantities and model-specific parameters, not direct couplings on the mass-coupling planes covered by AxionLimitBench.
